name: Plagued Lands
summary: Darkshore's wildlife is falling to a creeping sickness, and Tharnariun Treetender seeks a way to save it. He asks you to calm a rabid thistle bear with an enchanted relic and bring it back alive.

sections.title: A Blight on the Wilderness
sections.body: A creeping sickness twists Darkshore’s beasts into maddened, violent creatures. Thistle bears suffer most, and their frenzy threatens travelers and the coast’s fragile balance. Night elf sentinels answer with steel, while druids seek to understand the sickness and heal its cause.

sections.title: Tharnariun's Hope
sections.body: Tharnariun Treetender will not kill the corrupted beasts before trying to save them. He made a trap called Tharnariun’s Hope. Set on the forest floor, its soothing light briefly calms a raging thistle bear. Pacified, the bear follows you back to Tharnariun’s outpost for study.

sections.title: Tragic Medicine
sections.body: When an infected bear reaches camp, Tharnariun tries to purge its sickness with restorative magic. His first attempt ends in disaster. The cleansing energies overwhelm the weakened animal, and it collapses and dies. The failure shows how deeply the dark plague has taken hold.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Plagued Lands?
faq.answer: Tharnariun Treetender, a night elf druid in Auberdine, asks for your help. He seeks a cure for Darkshore’s afflicted wildlife.

faq.q: What is the objective of Plagued Lands?
aliases: what to do in plagued lands
faq.answer: Use Tharnariun’s Hope to trap and calm a Rabid Thistle Bear in Darkshore, then lead it back to Tharnariun alive.

faq.q: What happens to the bear when you bring it back?
faq.answer: Tharnariun tries to cleanse the bear with healing magic, but the sickness has advanced too far. The strain overwhelms it, and it dies after the treatment.

faq.q: What item do you use to capture the bear?
faq.answer: Tharnariun provides Tharnariun’s Hope, an enchanted trap. Its calming light pacifies the enraged bear so it will follow you.
Cleansing of the Infected follows Plagued Lands, then comes Tharnariun’s Hope.

faq.q: Why are the thistle bears rabid?
aliases: why are bears sick in darkshore
faq.answer: A creeping plague is spreading through Darkshore, poisoning local wildlife and driving thistle bears into mindless aggression.

angles.text: As a night elf, seeing Darkshore’s native flora and fauna fall to rabid madness affronts Cenarius and the balance of nature you are sworn to protect.
As a druid, you share Tharnariun’s grief as nature falls to corruption. The bear’s tragic loss shows how deeply the disease has spread through the land.
As an Alliance traveler crossing northern Kalimdor, you face untamed corruption pressing against the borders of settled lands.
